## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green (lint, scan, example tests).
- [ ] Any new GitHub Action is pinned to a full commit SHA with a version comment.
- [ ] Examples still run as non-root (`USER semgrep`) and were smoke-tested.
- [ ] Added/updated a fixture under `tests/fixtures/` for any new example.
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` (under `Unreleased`) and `README.md` if user-facing.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or customer data added.
